content: An ex-wife sought the reimbursement of substantial funds withdrawn by her husband from a joint account and the division of "comunione de residuo" (residuary community) assets,. The legal debate focused on the burden of proof for fund usage and the timing of the dissolution of the communion,. The judge held that under Article 192, a spouse who withdraws joint funds must provide rigorous evidence that the money was spent on family needs; failing this, they must reimburse half,. Furthermore, earnings not consumed by the date of the separation order were categorized as residuary community, entitling the other spouse to a 50% credit.
